transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, September 5. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'Hunchha': 9 days on, a miracle rescue in Nepal. 2 Men Pulled Out Of Trishuli 3A Hydropower Tunnel; 41 Were Believed Trapped As Flood Buried Project 'This is a mistake': Srikkanth slams India's 'fear-driven' squad for Afghan series. Former cricketer Kris Srikkanth criticised India's squad selection for the Afghanistan series. He believes selectors missed an opportunity to test younger players. Srikkanth described the decision as a mistake influenced by recent defeats. The selectors opted for an experienced team instead of experimenting with new talent. Jeff Bezos' ex-wife sets new record with donations to historically Black colleges. MacKenzie Scott has now donated over one billion dollars to historically Black colleges. Her recent forty-two million dollar gift to Elizabeth City State University marked this milestone. Scott has provided significant funding to numerous institutions since 2020. These unrestricted donations empower universities to allocate funds as needed. Delhi HC allows 2 'linked' to NEET leak to go for counselling. NEW DELHI: Delhi HC has directed National Testing Agency (NTA) to declare within 24 hours the NEET-UG re-examination results of two candidates, whose results were withheld over allegations linking them to the question paper leak. Alberta Premier Danielle Smith's message to international students: Study, then return home. Alberta's Premier Danielle Smith has made it clear that international students need to leave Canada once their study visas expire. She highlighted that these visas serve as temporary permits meant for academic pursuits, urging students to return to their home countries. This statement follows rising concerns over immigration programs misleading students about potential residency outcomes. With Canada tightening its immigration policies, unauthorized work could lead to serious repercussions. AI Phuket-Delhi flight incident: All 3 hydraulics failed in 'exceptionally rare' event. MUMBAI: Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau's preliminary report has confirmed what pilots and engineers call an exceptionally rare event, the near-simultaneous loss of all three hydraulic systems on the A320neo aircraft at 36,000 feet. Trump hails Bartiromo as 'true warrior' after Fox News exit. Donald Trump has praised Maria Bartiromo as a "true warrior" following her departure from Fox News Media, saying he "can't believe" she will no longer host her shows. Trump also warned that her many fans "will not be happy." Bartiromo's exit comes after more than 12 years with Fox, though her lawyer disputes reports that she was fired. Zelenskyy proposes ceasefire with Russia ahead of US envoys' Kyiv visit. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has proposed a ceasefire with Russia as US envoys visit Moscow and Kyiv, saying he hopes to host the American officials in Kyiv in the "coming days". Texas family conserves 470-acre farm after 115 years. Joseph Martinek purchased a Texas farm in 1911, beginning a family legacy that has lasted 115 years. In 2026, his descendants permanently protected 470 acres outside La Grange through a donated conservation easement. The property preserves farmland, wildlife habitat, open space, water resources and archaeological history while allowing the family to retain ownership and continue stewardship. Sam Altman denies one ChatGPT query uses 6hr shower water, gives almond example. Sam Altman refutes claims that AI computing consumes excessive water, emphasizing that contemporary data centers utilize advanced cooling technologies that differ significantly from outdated models. He likens the water consumption of AI systems to that of almond farming, dubbing prevalent narratives as misconceptions. Moreover, he notes that large data centers require a similar amount of water as typical office buildings. Sebi clears NSE's IPO papers, to be India's biggest so far. MUMBAI: Markets regulator Sebi on Friday cleared National Stock Exchange (NSE)'s offer document to go public through the initial public offer (IPO) estimated to be worth about rupees 30,000 crore. Glacial lake spurs disaster readiness push in Lahaul-Spiti. KULLU: Within days of the devastating Nepal floods, Lahaul Spiti administration has stepped up preparedness against a possible glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) risk, and begun 'highest flood level' (HFL) markings at 32 vulnerable locations along the likely flood path of Ghepan lake, considering its expansion from 36.5 hectares to 101.3 hectares in just 13 years.

Amid Rain and Protests, Ancient Khade Hanuman Idol Relocated In MP's Ujjain Under Heavy Police Cover. Ujjain Municipal Corporation relocated the ancient Khade Hanuman idol amid rain, protests and heavy police deployment on Friday, while the Taksali Ganesh idol could not be shifted. Bessent Sees Oil as Low as $40 Post-Iran War, Taking Yields Down. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said oil prices will nosedive to as low as $40 a barrel once the Iran conflict is over, pulling down bond yields that have lately hit the highest levels in years. Lemon Tree Hotels adds two properties in Bodhgaya, Bihar. Lemon Tree Hotel, Bodhgaya will feature 75 well-appointed rooms, a restaurant, banquet hall, meeting/conference room, swimming pool and a fitness center. Railway stock: RVNL shares to be in focus on Monday after rupees 903 crore order from SJVN. Shares of Rail Vikas Nigam are set to draw investor interest after receiving an award from SJVN for a construction project in Bihar. Despite recent stock declines, retail investors maintain a strong interest, holding 18.2 percent of shares, reflecting confidence in long-term growth prospects. Stanley Lifestyles unveils 72,000 sq.ft. flagship store in Hyderabad. Featuring more than 60 curated room settings, the flagship showcases fully realised living environments that demonstrate how furniture, design, lighting and dor can come together to create cohesive and personalised homes. SpaceX briefly reclaims $2 trillion market cap: Inside the massive stock rally fuelling Elon Musk's company. SpaceX shares surged 38 percent in five weeks to $150, fuelled by investor optimism in AI infrastructure and government spending. The stock's rebound reflects confidence in the company's growth strategy. Deepa Jewellers IPO ends with 42.61 times subscription. The offer received bids for 78.91 crore shares as against 1.85 crore shares on offer. Trump calls Iran conflict 'small potatoes'. US Iran war: American President Donald Trump defended Vice President JD Vance's remarks about the Iran conflict. NSE IPO: Explained What is an 'observation letter' issued by Sebi as regulator okays rupees 30,000 cr much-awaited issue. Sebi issued final observations for the NSE's IPO on September 4, allowing the exchange to proceed with its long-awaited public offering. The IPO will consist of a 149-million-equity-share offer, with market estimates valuing it at around rupees 30,000 crore. INR registers a weekly gain of over 1 percent. The Indian rupee settled for the day marginally higher by 2 paise at 94.49 (provisional) against the US dollar on Friday, supported by optimism over rising foreign inflows and a rise in risk appetite. The pair registered a weekly gain of 1.13 percent . However, rising crude oil prices and escalating US-Iran geopolitical tensions is seen limiting the upside gains. Local shares closed higher on Friday, with benchmark indexes snapping a four-day losing streak, as dovish comments from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller prompted traders to scale back expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase this month. HUL bets on cost cuts to revive growth: MD. Hindustan Unilever plans to boost growth by increasing capital expenditure and focusing on key areas. Pulse of the Street: US bond yields, interest rate jitters drag Indian equities lower this week. Indian equities fell about 1 percent this week as higher US Treasury yields, elevated crude prices and foreign selling weighed on sentiment. Friday's recovery offered little relief, with valuations, IPO supply and shifting rate expectations keeping investors cautious for the week ahead. The pact establishes a framework for cooperation and information exchange relating to central counterparties regulated and supervised by the Indian markets regulator PVR INOX executive shown door in April. A senior PVR INOX executive was asked to leave in April after an internal probe. NSE IPO listing date, timeline: When rupees 30,000 cr issue is expected to hit Indian stock market exchanges. The NSE IPO, approved by Sebi, is set to raise around rupees 30,000 crore, surpassing previous IPO records. Offering 149 million shares from existing shareholders, the IPO marks a significant milestone after years of delays due to regulatory issues and is expected to list in September 2024. As of 2:07 p.m. Eastern Time, the S and P 500 fell 0.5 percent . The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 0.5 percent and the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.5 percent . Japan stocks rebound as tech shares lead gains. At the same time, investors are watching the Bank of Japan for a possible rate increase at its September meeting as it looks to manage inflation. Sharp moves in the yen also remained a key focus after the currency gained as much as 3 percent over two sessions. Government floats fresh IT tenders at higher prices. NSE clears final Sebi hurdle for long-awaited IPO. Structured as an offer for sale, the NSE IPO and subsequent listing will resolve a decade-long wait triggered by regulatory issues.
